title: Delegated security admin: Position holders section offers Add / Remove on positions outside the delegated scope
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Filing gate: out-of-scope finding from the `os-dev` of #34741 (PR #35389), filed by seat 5 (area ux-1) on the seat's word. ⛔ Not a claim. Sub-issue of #34741: same shape, a sibling section. Grade p3: rides a same-file p2 later, never dispatched alone.

## What happens

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PositionHoldersSection.tsx` offers Add / Remove on every position. For a delegated security admin, the server refuses positions outside the caller's scope (403 `DELEGATION_SCOPE_VIOLATION`). The caller's own report (`useAuth().describeDelegableScope`, `scopes[].assignablePositions`) already names the positions they may assign. Not reproduced live; read from code.

## Expected

The same rule #34741 gives `AssignedUsersSection`: when the report names delegated scopes and the position is in none of their `assignablePositions`, show the holders but no Add / Remove. A tenant-level admin, a report with no delegated scope, and a missing / loading / failed report keep today's controls. No client copy of the server's rule (ADR-0090 D6/D12).

## Done when

One pin per control and per persona, with ablation, mirroring the #34741 tests.

Dedupe words: PositionHoldersSection, assignablePositions, delegated scope position add remove.
